outcome: Maternal antibody concentrations (RSV prefusion F, IAV-H3, IAV-H1 IgG)
Cord antibody concentrations (RSV prefusion F, IAV-H3, IAV-H1 IgG)
Cord to maternal IgG transfer ratios
cohort: The study included 115 maternal-infant pairs (pregnant individuals and their infants) encompassing both preterm and full-term deliveries, analyzed between 2018 and 2021.
finding: Maternal influenza vaccination led to higher maternal and cord antibody concentrations for IAV-H3 and IAV-H1, but preterm infants exhibited significantly lower cord to maternal IgG transfer ratios for IAV-H3 and RSV compared to full-term infants.
gest_age: The study included preterm (<37 weeks) and full-term infants.
